message.content: In July, Li Hua was asked to provide feedback on the new artisanal donuts that Hailey Johnson had been developing. Specifically, Hailey sought her opinion on which flavor she liked the most from these new donuts. Hailey expressed her eagerness to receive more feedback to further refine the donut flavors, and she noted that the chocolate hazelnut flavor was particularly popular among consumers. Hailey also inquired if Li Hua had any other suggestions for additional flavors to consider for the donut lineup, hinting at the possibility of seasonal fruit flavors like raspberry or lemon.
